sample_unit: de-identified patient reports rated by 5 neurologists
models_evaluated: Linus Health Core Cognitive Evaluation (Digital Clock and Recall + Life and Health Questionnaire)

links.outcome: Specialist neurologist appropriateness ratings of AI-linked CDS recommendations and pathways (median >=7 threshold)
links.effect: All cognitive-impairment recommendations met the threshold; all seven borderline/impaired-DCR pathways appropriate (median 7-8); two pathways fell below threshold (Green DCR median 6; anti-amyloid referral median 5).
links.quote: All cognitive-impairment recommendations met the threshold.

links.outcome: Independent clinical expert review of embedded clinical logic in decision support recommendations
links.effect: Five board-certified cognitive/behavioral neurologists rated CDS recommendations; most appropriate, with two pathways below threshold and moderate agreement (median ICC(2,k) 0.61 per patient).
links.quote: Five board-certified cognitive/behavioral neurologists independently rated CDS recommendations and nine predefined pathway parts for patients aged ≥55 across 21 de-identified reports.

screen.reason: Expert specialist validation study using a modified RAND/UCLA appropriateness method to evaluate the clinical decision support recommendations from a machine learning-enabled cognitive evaluation tool.
